ev.q: Among 719 NYC patients with probable or confirmed mpox, 704 (97.9%) were men
The median interval from symptom onset to diagnosis was 5 days (range = 3–7 days)
101 (14.0%) patients received tecovirimat, and 35 (4.9%) were hospitalized
More than two thirds of patients with proctitis or rectal symptoms did not report perianal skin lesions
Clinical and Epidemiologic Characteristics of Mpox Cases from the Initial Phase of the Outbreak
Using a standardized form, DOHMH staff members attempted to interview all NYC residents

methods_quotes.q: Using a standardized form, DOHMH staff members attempted to interview all NYC residents
For patients who declined an interview or were unreachable, information obtained from medical care providers during DOHMH consultation calls was used
Unknown category included patients with missing data or patients who responded “do not know” or “declined to answer” to the survey question
